name: AEO Schema
description: Structured data for answer engines: one JSON-LD @graph on every published page — Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList and Article — plus hand-written blocks per page. Managed from the admin, and changeable across the whole site in one API call.

settings.label: Write structured data into published pages
settings.description: Off leaves every published page exactly as the platform rendered it.

settings.label: Public address of the site
settings.description: With scheme, no trailing slash — https://www.drnahlah.com. Every @id, url and breadcrumb item in the graph is built from this, so with it empty the graph is emitted without them and answer engines cannot resolve the entities.

settings.label: What kind of organisation this is
settings.description: schema.org type for the practice. Dentist is a LocalBusiness subtype and is the specific one for a dental practice — prefer the most specific type that is true.

settings.label: Logo
settings.description: /uploads/... or a full https:// address. Used as the organisation's logo and as the publisher logo on every article.

settings.label: Price range
settings.description: Google shows this on a local business card. $$ or $$$ is the convention; leave empty to omit rather than guess.

settings.label: Profiles elsewhere
settings.description: One URL per line — Google Business Profile, Facebook, Instagram, Yelp, Healthgrades. This is how an answer engine ties the entity here to the entity it already knows.

settings.label: Organisation block, written by hand
settings.description: Optional, and it REPLACES everything above. Paste a full Organization / LocalBusiness object when the generated one cannot express the practice — two locations, a department list, opening hours per office. Must be one JSON object; it is validated before it can be saved.

settings.label: Organisation on every page
settings.description: The practice entity, with a stable @id, so every other node on every page can point at one organisation rather than re-declaring it.

settings.label: WebSite entity on the home page
WebPage for each page
settings.description: Name, description and URL for the page itself, tied to the WebSite and the organisation.

settings.label: Breadcrumbs
settings.description: A BreadcrumbList built from the page's own address. Google renders it in place of the raw URL in a result.

settings.label: Article for journal entries
settings.description: Headline, description, image, publish and modified dates and the publisher, for anything under a content table's route base.
